For today's lab, we will analyse the [debate between Jon Ossoff and Mike Collins](https://www.atlantanewsfirst.com/2026/10/09/read-full-transcript-us-senate-debate-between-jon-ossoff-mike-collins/), the candidates for the U.S. Senate in Georgia in the 2026 mid-term elections. 

(Note: if you've seen enough of this election, feel free to find a debate from another source to analyse)

## Data

You can use the code below to directly scrape the debate transcript from the news source:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(tidylo)
library(rvest)

url <- "https://www.atlantanewsfirst.com/2026/10/09/read-full-transcript-us-senate-debate-between-jon-ossoff-mike-collins/"
ps <- read_html(url) |> 
  html_elements("p") |> 
   html_text2()
d <- tibble(par=seq_along(ps), text=ps)
head(d)
```
